domain: Live TV (IPTV) — Reshaped reference → NuvioMobile iOS port

capabilities.capability: M3U playlist parsing — EXTINF, EXTVLCOPT, EXTHTTP, URL pipe headers, HLS stream detection, category-heading filtering, duplicate URL dedup
capabilities.source_behavior: Streaming line-by-line parser. Parses #EXTM3U url-tvg/x-tvg-url/tvg-url for EPG links. #EXT-X- tags mark HLS stream (single channel). #EXTINF reads tvg-id/tvg-logo/group-title/display-name. #EXTVLCOPT:http-user-agent and http-referrer accumulate pending headers. #EXTHTTP: parses JSON-like {key:val} headers. URL-pipe headers (url|Key=Val&Key2=Val2). Drops ignored lines and duplicates. Filters separator headings (##### SPORTS #####). Interning for shared group strings and header sets. Default headers: User-Agent VLC/3.0.0, Accept for mpegurl. Returns ParsedM3uPlaylist(channels, epgUrls, isHlsStream).
capabilities.target_behavior: Same function signature, line-by-line streaming. Parses #EXTM3U EPG URLs. #EXT-X- HLS detection. #EXTINF metadata (name/tvg-id/tvg-logo/group-title). #EXTVLCOPT User-Agent and Referer. URL-pipe headers. Category-heading filtering. Duplicate URL elimination. Default stream headers. Same ParsedM3uPlaylist return type.
gaps: Missing EXTHTTP header parsing (JSON key:value style) — reference parses #EXTHTTP:{'key':'val',...} format common in TVHeadend playlists
Missing string interning for groups and header sets — reference uses HashMap interning to reduce memory for 1000s of channels sharing few distinct groups/header combos
Missing Accept header in LIVE_TV_PLAYLIST_HEADERS (reference includes 'application/x-mpegURL, application/vnd.apple.mpegurl, audio/mpegurl, text/plain, */*')
platform_limitations: iOS Kotlin standard library — string interning may use Map with object references; acceptable to skip

capabilities.capability: XMLTV EPG parsing — streaming pull-parser, gzip detection, 100MB+ guide support, channel matching by tvgId then normalized name, truncated programme windowing
capabilities.source_behavior: Streaming pull-parser (XmlPullParser) with streaming input from LiveTvHttp.readFile (handles gzip or raw). Malformed tail does not fail the read (catches Exception). Programme windowing: LiveTvGuideWindow with pastMs/maxPast/aheadMs/maxAhead config (Regular=3h/6past/12h/18ahead, LowMemory=2h/4past/8h/10ahead). Channel matching: build LiveTvGuideRequest from channels (keys, keysByName using liveTvNameKey, keysWithoutLogo). LiveTvScheduleBuilder: match by channel id first, fall back to name-based alias matching. Deduplicates same-start programmes (guide channel matched by id and by name). Title interning. Logo extraction from <channel><icon src>. Truncated tracking for channels whose kept programmes were cut short. nextScheduleReadAt computes when to re-read based on truncated channel end times. currentProgrammes finds now-playing programme per key. TIMESTAMP parsing: XMLTV format (yyyyMMddHHmmss Z or local). Clock formatting: device time zone.

GUIDE_READ_TIMEOUT_S=120s. Buffer 64KB.

No switchToSourceStream for channel switching — only for stream selection within a single playback. PlayerScreenRuntimeEffects has no live overlay or channel zap.
capabilities.target_behavior: No live-specific discrimination in player screen runtime. contentType can be 'channel' but nothing special happens (no seek-disabled, no live latch, no unseekable, no progress-save skip). switchToSourceStream exists for normal stream switching but not tied to channel zapping.
gaps: No live latch or content-type-aware behavior in player runtime
No isSeekable=false for live channel content type
No skip-progress-save for channel content type
No live edge / behind-live-window detection in player runtime
No channel-specific error display (reconnect banner vs failed-load dialog)
switchToSourceStream exists but no zap mechanism (keep player across channel switches)
platform_limitations: MPV seek/keep behavior differs from ExoPlayer. MPV can keep player between loads with replace or loadfile append

capabilities.capability: Profile settings sync — existing sync infrastructure for Live TV integration
capabilities.source_behavior: ProfileSettingsSync handles per-profile preference sync via Supabase. SyncManager orchestrates full sync cycle. LiveTvSections (from reference) would slot into this as another section type. Currently no Live TV sections registered in target.
capabilities.target_behavior: Sync infrastructure exists (ProfileSettingsSync, SyncManager, SupabaseProvider) but has no Live TV data sections.
gaps: No Live TV sync sections in ProfileSettingsSync
No LiveTvSyncData serialization for sync
No applySync implementation for Live TV data

risks: CRITICAL: 17 of 32 capabilities entirely missing (missing: xtream-provider, stalker-provider, xmltv-epg-reader, guide-cache, livetv-http-client, multi-source-loading, persistence-storage, sync-model-and-sections, playback-policy, playback-registry, live-edge-recovery, ts-flags, load-error-policy, frame-rate-matching, preferences-settings, navigation-menu-entry, source-dialog, category-dialog, programme-guide, player-overlay, live-device, live-preview-player, guide-loader-epg-lifecycle, string-resources, sync-integration, player-screen-no-livetv-integration) — essential for any usable Live TV feature
CRITICAL: Target has 0 Live TV screens (no LiveTvScreen, no LiveTvPlayerOverlay, no LiveTvGuide, no dialogs) — the entire user-facing feature is absent

HIGH: MPV engine differences — reference uses ExoPlayer with TS flags, load error policies, live edge recovery, frame rate measurement via VideoFrameMetadataListener. MPV on iOS has different mechanisms for these (--keep-open, --ts-* flags, observe_property). Ports of these capabilities must use MPV-specific approaches
HIGH: HTTP client dependency — reference uses OkHttp for playlist/guide/provider fetches. iOS needs KMP-compatible HTTP (Ktor/Kohttp or platform URL loading) for Xtream/Stalker/XMLTV downloads
MEDIUM: XML streaming — reference uses XmlPullParser for XMLTV. iOS/KMP lacks this; needs SAX/XMLReader or KMP XML library alternative

MEDIUM: Preview player — reference uses separate ExoPlayer instance at lowest bitrate. iOS preview would need second MPV instance or platform streaming (MediaPlayer/VideoView) which may have different resource profiles

MEDIUM: Threading model differences — reference uses Android TV-specific constructs (WeakHashMap for frame meter, ConcurrentHashMap for sessions, Semaphore for load permits, serial dispatchers). iOS KMP needs equivalent synchronisation primitives
MEDIUM: 3 Kotlin Live TV files exist in target (models, parser, parser test) with partial coverage — these can serve as baseline but need extension; models missing LiveTvUiState entirely
LOW: String resources — 116 Android XML strings need iOS .strings / KMP resource file
LOW: Setup server — NanoHTTPD not available on iOS; needs alternative (raw ServerSocket-based HTTP server or embedded Jetty/Ktor adapter)
VERIFIED EQUIVALENT: Channel name normalization (liveTvNameKey, liveTvGuideKey, liveTvHideKey) already ported correctly to target models
